title: Choose the scientific primitive first; use recent flagship carriers as qualified realizations
trigger: The prior STRI manuscript had a broad representation-invariance theory but a load-bearing lifecycle witness centered on arXiv-only Skill-SP, creating a mismatch between claim breadth and carrier relevance.

lesson.core_rule: For papers that diagnose or intervene on prior agent methods, define the shared computational primitive and scientific invariant before choosing a carrier. The main empirical carrier should preferably be a recent peer-reviewed flagship realization with public code and a real downstream benchmark; a niche or arXiv-only system may remain as a mechanistic microscope but should not carry broad audience relevance alone.
carrier_gate: recent flagship venue, preferably current-year frontier plus an older mature anchor
source/runtime can be pinned before outcome-bearing execution
lesson.operator_rule: Do not transplant one carrier's formula to another. Derive the representation-sensitive sufficient state from each carrier's actual operator, then test the shared invariant across operator-specific specializations.
lesson.dedup_rule: Semantic duplicate detection is not equivalent to merge-sufficient state. If evidence is partitioned or irreversibly compressed before semantic reunion, a later deduplication step can recognize equivalence while still being unable to recover the missed learning/evolution decision.
lesson.evidence_ladder: source audit -> zero-provider deterministic operator witness -> unchanged author scheduler reachability -> real frozen trajectories/model-dependent evolution -> held-out behavioral propagation -> cross-carrier replication
lesson.claim_rule: A released-code threshold specialization supports mechanism existence only. Broad self-improvement claims require task-level propagation and at least one independent recent flagship representation family or a theory-predicted positive control.

skillpro_instantiation.released_code_witness: M=6 identity-local experience buffer, canonical 6 versus exact 3+3
skillpro_instantiation.coordinates: q=N/M, p=max_i n_i/M; evolution-fragmented regime q>=1>p
skillpro_instantiation.native_ordering_observation: Skill evolution executes before semantic maintenance/dedup in the pinned release
skillpro_instantiation.current_status: qualified for P1/P2 design after zero-provider P0 and author-scheduler P0b; not yet sufficient to recenter the manuscript

anti_patterns: choose a carrier only because its threshold makes the theorem easy
choose a famous carrier whose identity cannot be intervened on cleanly
relabel metadata/catalog stress as real task-performance evidence
change carrier, task, alias count, or threshold after seeing outcome-bearing results
treat a late semantic dedup as proof that earlier identity-local credit is representation-invariant
